title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E01 — Dinner for Two
Chef Gabe Bertaccini makes gnocchi di ricotta alla sorrentina and lasagna bianca; the pillowy ricotta gnocchi are baked in a bright tomato sauce with melted mozzarella and this lasagna goes all-in on creamy béchamel, layers of pasta and melty cheese.

title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E02 — Seafood Feast
Gabe makes a seafood feast with roasted branzino and seafood stew.

title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E04 — Chicken
Chef Gabe Bertaccini dives into two beloved classics, starting with Chicken al Mattone, a Tuscan classic with incredibly crispy skin and juicy meat. Then, fresh Chicken Parmesan is bold and delicious with blistered cherry tomatoes and basil.

title: Cook Like an Italian With Gabe Bertaccini
description:
S01 E05 — Primo to Secondo
Chef Gabe Bertaccini takes our taste buds to central Italy, beginning with Crespelle alla Fiorentina, delicate Italian crêpes filled with creamy ricotta and spinach. Then, Lamb Chops Scottadito is made complete with a side of Herb Cast-Iron Potatoes.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S15 E02 — B-Man and Me
Ree Drummond spends some quality time with her son, Bryce, by making him beef fajita nachos; slow cooker white chicken chili; orange-vanilla monkey bread; meat and potato scramble.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S22 E01 — Double Care Package
Ree makes care packages for her two daughters in college; she sends them homemade breakfast tarts, nut and seed brittle, salt and pepper crackers and cherry gummies; Ree's sons get involved, too, shopping for fun treats to send to their sisters.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S34 E07 — Merc Homemade
Ree Drummond shares homemade takes on star dishes from her Mercantile store; she makes BBQ Glazed Half Chicken with Balsamic Bacon Brussels Sprouts, Chocolate Almond Croissants, Parmesan Garlic Fries and an easy Roasted Vegetable Quesadilla.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S35 E09 — Rotisserie Chicken Dinners 4 Ways
Ree Drummond turns rotisserie chicken into four quick dinners; she makes a shortcut chicken, sausage and gnocchi, and mixes up a hickory BBQ chicken salad; she stuffs chicken artichoke bread bombs and saves time with fried chicken verde tacos.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S38 E01 — Paige on the Ranch
Ree is making a well-earned lunch for Ladd and his new cowgirl, Paige, who are out shipping cattle; pasta with pancetta and corn; lemon pepper chopped salad; individual skillet focaccia; easy chocolate orange ice cream.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S39 E01 — Eat Your Protein
Ree Drummond is sharing four protein-packed and super easy dishes; first, Ree makes fish taco salad with delicious, spiced cod, a chile lime yogurt dressing and amazing mango pico de gallo.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E01 — Christina Tosi
Pastry chef and Milk Bar founder Christina Tosi joins Ina Garten to share stories about life-changing career decisions and dessert revelations. Ina makes Smoked Salmon Tartines, and Christina shares the secrets to Milk Bar's legendary Birthday Cake.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S07 E02 — Jon Batiste
Musician Jon Batiste joins Ina Garten for a conversation about staying strong and making Grammy history; Ina makes peanut butter and jelly bars for a taste of nostalgia and Jon shares his Ma's Louisiana-style red beans and rice.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S29 E16 — Bottomless Brunch
A bottomless brunch that starts with bacon, egg and cheese slider casserole; the hosts collaborate on a continental brunch board, and the menu also includes loaded home fries and sheet pan swirl pancakes.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S39 E09 — Meat & Potatoes
Cooking up meat and potatoes, including brown sugar vinegar ribs, crispy potato cakes with miso lime vinaigrette and a Chicago style hot dog; Maneet Chauhan stops by to make a masala ribeye and cumin potatoes.

title: Haunted Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S02 E01 — Calling All Ghostbusters
Clinton Kelly challenges three gingerbread artists to create pieces celebrating the 35th anniversary of the movie "Ghostbusters;" the competitor who impresses judges Jamika Pessoa, Gesine Prado and Jason Smith qualifies for the finale.

title: Haunted Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S02 E03 — The Mummy's Ancient Curse
Three gingerbread artists take on the mummy's ancient curse when Clinton Kelly challenges them to use gingerbread to tell a story of mummies run amok; judges Jamika Pessoa, Gesine Prado and Jason Smith decide who moves on to the finale.

title: Haunted Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S02 E02 — When Aliens Attack
Clinton Kelly challenges three gingerbread artists to create pieces that depict the chaos of an alien attack; the competitor who can win over judges Jamika Pessoa, Gesine Prado and Jason Smith with their little green men earns a spot in the finale.

title: Haunted Gingerbread Showdown
description:
S02 E04 — Scares on Elm Street
The finalists have one week to create pieces that celebrate the 35th anniversary of the movie "A Nightmare on Elm Street;" the judges award the title and $25,000 prize to the gingerbread artist who creates the best nightmare-scape and pyrotechnics.

Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create terrifying insect-infested showpieces and daring buzz-worthy desserts inspired by coffee, tea and spirits; after an unexpected twist, judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller execute an elimination.

Bennett asks the teams to go head-to-head with terrifying trolls, demons and ghouls. But as rivalries heat up and tensions rise, one team faces an emotional fight to impress judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller enough to stay in the competition.

Peaches and pancetta in the appetizer basket make for a creative first round; an unusual pork product in the entrée basket is a little bit gory; the chefs are challenged to figure out the best way to make it shine on the plate.

Ted is in charge of the baskets; in the first round, he challenges the chefs with a wildly unusual product in a tube and his favorite snack of all time; the final basket includes an exotic extract and an Italian dessert that Ted can never pass up.
